rule.description: The latest version; unset when the account never had a rule.

conversionTwapDurationMs.description: Duration of a conversion that runs as TWAP, in milliseconds, as a decimal string; '0' when the rule pays in kind.

createdByAccountId.description:
Public account ID of the person who created this version.

Public ID, as a base58 string.

destinations.description: One destination per paid asset, ordered by asset_id. Empty only on a version that was disabled before pausing kept destinations.

assetId.description: Ledger asset paid. At most one destination per asset.

destinationAddress.description: Destination address on destination_chain_id. It must be on the account's external withdraw whitelist when the rule is written and whenever a run pays it. Responses carry its canonical form.

destinationChainId.description: Polyester chain id of the destination network: ChainConfig.chain_id from GetDepositWithdrawConfig, not the network's native chain id (ChainConfig.native_chain_id).

maxAmount.description: The most one run pays the asset, as a decimal string in whole units of the asset.

minAmount.description: A run pays the asset only from this amount, as a decimal string in whole units of the asset, for example '0.5'.

minFloor.description: The least amount one payout to this destination can pay now, as a decimal string in whole units of the asset: the route's withdrawal minimum, and more than its current network fee. It follows the network fee, so it can change between reads. Absent when the route or its network fee is not known now.

enabled.description: Whether the rule runs. A paused version (enabled false) keeps its schedule and destinations, so it resumes to the same destinations. The rule runs only while enabled and without a pause.

minUsdValue.description: Least USD value one payout pays, as a decimal string in whole USD, for example '25'; '0' means no USD minimum.

pause.description: Set when the rule paused itself; resuming it or setting a new rule clears it.

assetId.description: Asset whose payout paused the rule; zero when no payout did.

reason.description: Machine-readable reason: destination_not_whitelisted when the destination left the account's external withdraw whitelist, destination_invalid when it is no longer a valid destination, or authority_revoked when the person who set the rule may no longer change it or withdraw from the account. On a broker vault the rule pauses with authority_revoked as soon as its author's broker role changes in any way: removed, demoted, or promoted (for example Finance to Owner), and also when the author is removed and added back. An Owner or Finance member resumes it with a fresh step-up.

payoutAssetId.description: Ledger asset every other asset with a balance is converted into, through a Swap placed from the account, before the run pays it; zero pays every asset in kind. When set, destinations has exactly one entry, for this asset.

anchorDate.description: A UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD) in a week a BIWEEKLY rule runs; weeks start on Monday. Responses return the Monday that starts that week.

dayOfMonth.description: Run day of a MONTHLY rule, 1 to 31; see MONTHLY for shorter months.

minuteOfDay.description: Minute after 00:00 UTC the run starts, 0 to 1439, for every cadence but HOURLY; must be 0 for an hourly rule.

minuteOfHour.description: Minute past every hour an HOURLY rule is checked, 0 to 59.

weekday.description: Run day of a weekly or biweekly rule.

subaccountId.description:
Public subaccount ID the rule belongs to; zero for the root account.

Public ID, as a base58 string.

nextPageToken.description: Cursor for the next page. Empty when no more results exist.

runs.description: Runs ordered by run_seq, newest first.

conversions.description: Conversions into the rule's payout asset, ordered by source_asset_id; empty for an in-kind rule.

amount.description: Amount the conversion spends, as a decimal string in whole units of the source asset.

executedAmount.description: Source asset spent, settled, as a decimal string in whole units.

execution.description: Market or TWAP; unset when the asset was not converted.

durationMs.description: Total execution duration in milliseconds, from 60000 (1 minute) to 86400000 (24 hours). The duration starts when execution starts, not when the Swap is created.

sliceIntervalMs.description: Interval between slices in milliseconds, from 10000 (10 seconds) up to duration_ms. The slice count is duration_ms / slice_interval_ms, rounded up.

isTerminal.description: Whether the conversion is over: its Swap is terminal, or it was skipped.

fee.description: Fee the leg paid in the asset it received, as a decimal string in whole units.

feeAssetId.description: Asset the leg's fee was charged in: the asset it received.

leg.description: Route leg: 0, or 1 for a route's second leg.

received.description: Asset the leg received after its fee, as a decimal string in whole units.

side.description: Whether the leg bought or sold the market's base asset.

spent.description: Asset the leg spent, as a decimal string in whole units.

symbolId.description: Spot market the leg traded on.

reason.description: Why a terminal Swap did not trade its whole amount; absent when it did or when the asset was not converted.

receivedAmount.description: Payout asset received after fees, as a decimal string in whole units.

skipReason.description: Why the asset was not converted (route_unsupported, below_minimum, above_maximum, conversion_unavailable, price_unavailable, conversion_refused, rule_superseded or policy_denied); empty otherwise. Its balance stays on the account.

status.description: Where the Swap stands; absent when the asset was not converted (skipReason says why).

swapId.description: The Swap that converts the asset; absent when the asset was not converted.

unspentAmount.description: Source asset left on the account, as a decimal string in whole units.

finishedAt.description: When the run ended; unset while it is in progress.

reason.description: Machine-readable reason for a skipped run: nothing_to_pay, price_unavailable (an asset was not paid because no current price valued it) or rule_superseded; empty otherwise.

ruleVersion.description: The rule version the run executes.

runSeq.description: The account's run number, increasing by one per run.

scheduledFor.description: The scheduled slot the run belongs to.

steps.description: One step per destination of the rule version, ordered by asset_id. Empty while the run is planned.

amount.description: What the step pays, as a decimal string in whole units of the asset; '0' when skipped.

available.description: The account's available balance of the asset when the run started, as a decimal string in whole units of the asset.

intentId.description: Withdraw intent identifier once the withdrawal is accepted; follows the same lifecycle as a user withdrawal.

networkFee.description: The network fee charged on the withdrawal, as a decimal string in whole units of the asset. Once it completed, the destination received amount minus this fee; once Zipper rejected it or its execution failed, the fee Zipper kept, which is not refunded. Absent until the step is final, when it was skipped or failed before it reached Zipper, and when the fee was not reported.

reason.description: Machine-readable reason for a skipped or failed step, such as below_minimum, price_unavailable (the rule has a USD minimum and no current price valued the asset; the funds stay for a later run), rule_superseded, destination_not_whitelisted, destination_cooling_down (a broker vault's destination added to its external withdraw whitelist less than 24 hours ago; the funds stay for a later run), route_suspended (withdrawals of the asset to the destination network are suspended, as its withdrawal_status SUSPENDED in the deposit and withdraw config shows; the funds stay for a later run), supply_unavailable (the destination route's supply_status in the deposit and withdraw config is MISSING or STALE; the funds stay for a later run), authority_revoked, gateway_capacity_insufficient (the funds stay for a later run), withdrawals_disabled (the environment does not allow withdrawals; the funds stay on the account), withdrawal_released or withdrawal_failed; empty otherwise.

txHash.description: Destination-network transaction hash, set once Zipper committed the withdrawal's destination transaction and empty before. On a completed step it is the delivery. When the withdrawal's execution failed after that commit, the step fails with withdrawal_failed and keeps this hash: the funds were not returned to the account, and the bridge operator reviews the withdrawal.

valueUsd.description: USD value of the payable amount when the run started, as a decimal string in whole USD; absent when the rule has no USD minimum or no current price was available.

assets.description: One entry per destination of the rule, then per other asset with a positive balance, ordered by asset_id. Empty when the account has no rule or the rule is paused.

available.description: The account's available balance of the asset now, as a decimal string in whole units of the asset.

conversion.description: Set on an asset the rule converts into its payout asset: what converting its whole available balance is quoted to deliver now. Such an asset pays nothing in kind (payable_e18 zero); its hold_reason is converts, or why it would stay on the account.

execution.description: How the run would execute the conversion: market, or TWAP over the rule's conversion duration when its USD value exceeds 10,000 or its price impact exceeds 0.5%. A TWAP whose slices would fall below the route's minimum runs in fewer, longer slices, never fewer than two; otherwise the asset is skipped with below_minimum.

durationMs.description: Total execution duration in milliseconds, from 60000 (1 minute) to 86400000 (24 hours). The duration starts when execution starts, not when the Swap is created.

sliceIntervalMs.description: Interval between slices in milliseconds, from 10000 (10 seconds) up to duration_ms. The slice count is duration_ms / slice_interval_ms, rounded up.

expectedAmountOut.description: Expected payout asset after every leg's fee, as a decimal string in whole units, estimated from the whole amount at the current book depth; a TWAP's slices execute at the prices of their own time.

minAmountOut.description: Least payout asset the conversion accepts, as a decimal string in whole units: the expected amount less the 1% slippage protection, estimated the same way.

priceImpactBps.description: Quoted price impact of the whole amount, in basis points.

skipReason.description: Why the asset would not be converted now (route_unsupported, below_minimum, above_maximum, conversion_unavailable, price_unavailable); empty when it would. Its balance stays on the account.

destinationAddress.description: Canonical destination address; absent when the rule has no destination for the asset.

destinationChainId.description: External destination chain identifier; absent when the rule has no destination for the asset.

heldBack.description: What would stay on the account, as a decimal string in whole units of the asset: available minus payable.

holdReason.description: Why held_back_e18 stays, or why nothing pays: below_minimum (below minimum_e18 or the rule's min_usd_value_e18), price_unavailable (the rule has a USD minimum and no current price values the asset), no_destination (the rule pays no destination for the asset), destination_cooling_down (a broker vault pays a destination only once it has been on the vault's external withdraw whitelist for 24 hours; see payable_from), above_max (the balance above max_amount_e18 stays), dust (less than one whole on-chain unit stays) or, on a rule with a payout asset, converts (the asset is converted into the payout asset instead; see conversion) or why it would not be converted (see conversion.skip_reason); empty when the whole balance pays.

minimum.description: The least one payout of the asset pays, as a decimal string in whole units of the asset: the destination's minAmount, or its minFloor when that is higher and known now. Absent when the rule has no destination for the asset.

networkFee.description: The network fee a payout to the destination is expected to be charged now, as a decimal string in whole units of the asset; the destination receives about payable minus this fee. Absent when the rule has no destination for the asset or the fee is not known now.

networkFeeSampledAt.description: When network_fee_e18 was sampled; unset with it.

payable.description: What the run would pay, as a decimal string in whole units of the asset; '0' when the asset holds. The network fee is taken out of it on the way.

payableFrom.description: Present only on a broker vault while the destination is cooling down: when it can be paid, RFC 3339 UTC, 24 hours after it was added to the vault's external withdraw whitelist. Absent with holdReason destination_cooling_down when that time is not known yet.

pricedAt.description: When the price behind value_usd_e18 was observed; unset with it.

valueUsd.description: USD value of what the asset pays before its minimums, as a decimal string in whole USD, at the current price as of pricedAt. Absent when no current price values the asset or the rule has no destination for it.

computedAt.description: When the balances, prices and fees the preview used were read, RFC 3339 UTC.

minUsdValue.description: The rule's least USD value of one payout, as a decimal string in whole USD; '0' means no USD minimum. Absent when the account has no rule.

nextRunAt.description: When the next run starts, RFC 3339 UTC; for an hourly rule, the next hourly check. Absent when the account has no rule or the rule is paused.

pause.description: Set when the rule paused itself; a rule paused by a person has none.

assetId.description: Asset whose payout paused the rule; zero when no payout did.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.BIWEEKLY: Every two weeks on weekday at minute_of_day UTC: in the week of anchor_date and every second week before or after it.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DAILY: Once a day at minute_of_day UTC.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.HOURLY: Checked every hour at minute_of_hour UTC; pays only an asset whose payable amount has reached its minimums, so a payout follows within the hour of the balance reaching them. An hour with nothing to pay records no run.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MONTHLY: Once a month on day_of_month at minute_of_day UTC. A month without that day runs on its last day: day 31 runs on April 30 and on February 28 or 29, and days 29 and 30 run on the last day of February.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.WEEKLY: Once a week on weekday at minute_of_day UTC.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.NO_DESTINATION: Nothing would pay, and every positive balance is in an asset the rule has no destination for.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAUSED: The rule is paused, by a person or by itself (see pause); no run starts until it is resumed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ROLLS_OVER: Nothing would pay: every asset with a destination is below its minimum or the rule's USD minimum, has no current price for that minimum, or pays a broker vault's destination that is still cooling down. The balance stays on the account for a later run.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.WILL_PAY: At least one asset would pay.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.COMPLETED: Every payout completed or was skipped, and at least one paid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CONVERTING: The run's conversions into the payout asset are executing; payouts start once every conversion is final and settled.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FAILED: Every attempted payout failed. Each failed step says where its funds are (FAILED).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PARTIALLY_FAILED: Some payouts failed. Each failed step says where its funds are (FAILED).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAYING: The run's payouts are in progress.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PLANNED: The run is reading the account's balances.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SKIPPED: Nothing was paid: every asset was below its minimum, no current price valued it, or the rule was no longer current.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.FAILED: The withdrawal failed. Where its funds are depends on when it failed, which its withdrawal flow shows: - before it left the account: they stay on the account; - rejected by Zipper (flow REFUNDED, reason ZIPPER_VALIDATION_REJECTED or ZIPPER_EXECUTION_REJECTED): amount_e18 less network_fee_e18 is refunded, as zTokens, to the account's smart account wallet, not to the account's balance, and the network fee is not refunded; - its execution failed after its destination transaction was sent (flow FAILED, reason ZIPPER_WITHDRAW_EXECUTION_FAILED): Zipper reviews it and settles it outside Polyester Chain; nothing is returned to the account.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SKIPPED: Nothing was paid for this asset in this run.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SUBMITTED: Withdrawal accepted; waiting for it to complete on chain.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.BUY: Buy the market's base asset with its quote asset.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SELL: Sell the market's base asset for its quote asset.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.EXPIRED: The execution window ended before the order could be placed, or a TWAP's deadline ended it with slots left untraded.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE: The Trading balance did not cover the amount when the order was placed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INTERMEDIATE_BELOW_MINIMUM: On a two-leg route, intermediate asset below the second market's minimum order, with later slices' intermediate added where a TWAP had slices left, stays on the account, unconverted (intermediate_remainder_e18).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MARKET_UNAVAILABLE: The market was closed, halted, restricted or without liquidity.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MAX_ORDER_QUANTITY: The order bought the market's maximum order quantity and stopped there; the rest of the amount stays on the account, unspent. The market's depth or maximum changed after the quote, which never quotes past it.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MINIMUM_NOT_MET: A fill netted less than the accepted minimum rate. The Swap failed closed: the amounts show exactly what was traded and received.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ORDER_REJECTED: The order was refused, for example by the sub-account's trading policy.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ORDER_SIZE_OUT_OF_RANGE: The order was outside the market's size limits.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PRICE_PROTECTION: The order books could not fill the rest at a price that meets min_amount_out.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.RATE_LIMITED: The account's order rate limit was reached.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.USER_CANCELED: The Swap's owner canceled it (CancelSwap) before its whole amount traded.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.CANCELED: The Swap's owner canceled it (CancelSwap) before its whole amount traded. The amounts show exactly what traded and settled; the unspent amount and any intermediate_remainder_e18 stay on the account. reason is USER_CANCELED.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CANCELING: The Swap's owner canceled it (CancelSwap) and the cancel is taking effect: no new slice or first-leg order is sent. An order already sent finishes, and a slice whose first leg traded still sends its second leg. The Swap then becomes terminal: CANCELED, or the outcome it would have had when the cancel came too late to stop anything. This usually takes seconds. While an order's outcome is being confirmed the Swap is RECONCILING instead, and CANCELING again once it is, until it ends.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.COMPLETED: The whole amount was traded and settled (a remainder smaller than one order step stays on the account, unspent).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.EXECUTING: The Swap is accepted and its orders are being placed, filled or settled.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FAILED: Nothing was traded and the whole amount stays on the account, or, with reason MINIMUM_NOT_MET, a fill netted less than the accepted minimum rate; reason says why, and the amounts show what was traded.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PARTIALLY_COMPLETED: Part of the amount was traded and settled; the rest stays on the account, unspent. reason says why.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.RECONCILING: An order's outcome is being established. Balances already reflect any settled fill; the Swap stays here until the outcome is confirmed. A canceled Swap shows RECONCILING too while it waits for such an outcome (see CancelSwap).

ApiKeyIdAuth.description: ID of the API key that signs the request. An API-key request sends it with X-API-TIMESTAMP and X-API-SIGNATURE.
ApiKeyIdAuth.name: X-API-KEY-ID

ApiKeySignatureAuth.description: Ed25519 signature of the request, made with the API key's private key and encoded as hex or base64. An API-key request sends it with X-API-KEY-ID and X-API-TIMESTAMP.
ApiKeySignatureAuth.name: X-API-SIGNATURE

ApiKeyTimestampAuth.description: Time the request was signed, in Unix milliseconds. An API-key request sends it with X-API-KEY-ID and X-API-SIGNATURE.
ApiKeyTimestampAuth.name: X-API-TIMESTAMP

BrokerApiKeyAuth.description: Broker API key, sent as a bearer token and accepted only by the QuickSwap broker API. The broker API key is a server credential. Call this API from the broker's backend, never from a browser or mobile app. The broker's members create, rotate and revoke keys through the QuickSwap broker API, and a key may rotate itself.

info.title: Polyester API

get.description: Preview the account's next auto-withdraw run from its balances now: when it starts, whether it would pay, and per asset what it would pay, what would stay and why, its USD value and the expected network fee. A price that is not current leaves the value absent instead of failing the read.

parameters.description:
Public subaccount ID; omit for the caller's root account.

Public ID, as a base58 string.
parameters.name: subaccountId

get.x-poly-rest-note: This operation uses REST-friendly types: decimal strings for quantities/prices, base58 strings for IDs.

get.description: Read the latest version of the account's auto-withdraw rule. The rule is absent when the account never had one.

parameters.description:
Public subaccount ID; omit for the caller's root account.

Public ID, as a base58 string.
parameters.name: subaccountId

get.x-poly-rest-note: This operation uses REST-friendly types: decimal strings for quantities/prices, base58 strings for IDs.

put.description: Create the account's auto-withdraw rule or replace its latest version. Session login and a fresh step-up only; every destination must be on the account's external withdraw whitelist.
put.x-poly-rest-note: This operation uses REST-friendly types: decimal strings for quantities/prices, base58 strings for IDs.

put.description: Pause or resume the account's auto-withdraw rule, keeping its schedule and destinations. Session login only; resuming also needs a fresh step-up and checks every destination again.
put.x-poly-rest-note: This operation uses REST-friendly types: decimal strings for quantities/prices, base58 strings for IDs.

get.description: List the account's auto-withdraw runs with their payouts, newest first.

parameters.description: Maximum number of runs to return: 0 or omitted means 20, at most 100.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Cursor from a previous response's nextPageToken; omit for the first page.
parameters.name: pageToken
